articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that collapses previously separate models into one system. Benchmarks show substantial gains on PhD-level science questions and complex multi-step coding tasks, though independent evaluations are still underway.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Agentic Coding and Research Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra with a 2-million-token context window and state-of-the-art performance on SWE-Bench and GPQA-Diamond. The model introduces improved tool-use orchestration that allows it to autonomously chain web search, code execution, and file analysis in a single turn, positioning it as a leading model for agentic enterprise workflows.

articles.title: Figure AI Deploys Humanoid Robots at BMW Spartanburg Plant for Full-Shift Operations
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 02 humanoid robots are now operating full 8-hour shifts at BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina facility, handling bin-picking, parts transfer, and quality inspection tasks. This marks one of the first scaled commercial deployments of general-purpose humanoid robots in automotive manufacturing, with BMW reporting a measurable reduction in ergonomic injury incidents.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Warehouse Navigation and Manipulation
articles.summary: Tesla showcased an updated Optimus Gen 3 prototype performing end-to-end autonomous warehouse logistics including navigation through dynamic environments, shelf stocking, and package sorting without teleoperation. The system uses a vision-only transformer pipeline similar to Tesla's FSD architecture, raising questions about whether camera-only approaches can match lidar-equipped competitors in unstructured environments.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Tool-Use Sandbox for Secure Enterprise Agent Deployments
articles.summary: Anthropic unveiled a containerized execution environment for Claude-based agents that provides fine-grained permission controls, audit logging, and automatic rollback for actions taken against enterprise systems. The sandbox aims to address a key blocker for enterprise AI agent adoption—controllability and reversibility—by letting IT teams define strict action boundaries while still allowing agents to operate autonomously within those bounds.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm A16 Process for Next-Generation AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its Arizona and Tainan fabs have begun volume production on the A16 (2nm-class) process node using backside power delivery, with initial customers including Apple and NVIDIA. The node delivers approximately 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N3E, which is expected to meaningfully increase inference throughput per watt for next-generation data center GPUs.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained below-threshold error rates on logical qubits using a combination of Quantinuum's trapped-ion hardware and Microsoft's qubit virtualization layer. The demonstration ran a 24-logical-qubit chemistry simulation that would be intractable classically, marking a credible milestone toward practically useful quantum computation, though scaling remains a significant engineering challenge.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits Targeting Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The EU AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act's general-purpose AI provisions, requesting technical documentation from several large foundation model providers operating in Europe. The audits focus on systemic risk assessments, training data transparency, and red-teaming procedures, setting an early precedent for how the regulation will be practically enforced and interpreted.
